item.name: buckets
item.description: Bucket lifecycle for hackathon developers. Public buckets are created synchronously; private (Seal-encrypted) buckets need a reserve → (optional Enoki sponsor/execute) → finalize handshake. Delete + rename ops live at this folder's top level since they're scope-agnostic.

query.description: Maximum number of buckets to return.
Opaque cursor returned by a previous response's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.
Case-insensitive substring match on bucket name.
Filter buckets by visibility (public | private).
Field to sort by (date = createdAt).
Sort direction (asc | desc).

request.description: List buckets in a space, paginated. Returns `{ buckets: [...], next_cursor: string | null }`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` on the next call until it comes back `null`. Supports filtering by visibility + a case-insensitive substring search on name.

variable.description: Bucket UUID (set by List buckets / Create bucket)

request.description: Fetch a single bucket by id (`GET /buckets/:id`). Returns the full Bucket payload under `data` — id, space_id, name, visibility, seal_policy_id (null for public), storage_used, timestamps. Use this after List buckets to inspect one in detail, or after Create/Finalize to confirm the post-handshake state.

item.name: Create bucket flow
item.description: Reserve → sign → finalize handshake for private (Seal-encrypted) buckets. (1) Reserve to get the Enoki-sponsored tx bytes; the Reserve post-response script signs them locally (inlined tweetnacl + blakejs) and stashes the signature. (2) Finalize submits the signature so Harbor can broadcast the sponsored tx and activate the bucket. Public bucket creation is disabled at the API boundary in alpha.

request.description: Reserve a private bucket. Returns bucket_id, bytes (base64 Enoki-sponsored Sui tx with your service-key address as sender), digest, and state=pending. Sign bytes with harborServicePrivateKey, then call 2. Finalize. Your service key needs no SUI balance — gas is sponsored by Harbor.

request.description: Finalize the private bucket by submitting your signature over the reserved tx bytes from 1. Reserve (same Reserve → Sign → Finalize flow as `api/scripts/e2e-private-bucket.ts`). Signing now happens in 1. Reserve's post-response script, which stores the Sui signature envelope in `reservedSignature`; this request just submits it. Harbor executes the sponsored tx server-side and returns `{ bucket_id, seal_policy_id, state: "active" }`.

variable.description: Harbor API key — paste the full `hbr_<32 chars>` value returned once on POST /api/v1/api-keys. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <bearerToken>` for every request that doesn't override auth.
harbor_session JWT — set only when invoking the session-only endpoints (account linking, space/bucket CRUD, /api/v1/api-keys lifecycle). Obtain via POST /auth/session.

Service-account private key — shown once on POST /api/v1/api-keys alongside the hbr_ token. Not sent in HTTP headers. Used CLIENT-SIDE to Seal-decrypt private bucket downloads. Referred to as HARBOR_SERVICE_PRIVATE_KEY.
